title: AJ Brown 2023 Panini Prizm Fireworks Philadelphia Philly Eagles #F-23 NFL
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This is a stunning AJ Brown 2023 Panini Prizm Fireworks trading card featuring the Philadelphia Eagles player in his signature move. The card is made of high-quality card stock with a thickness of 35 Pt. and an English language print. It is an original insert card manufactured by Panini in the United States for the National Football League (NFL) league.

The card is licensed and has a unique Prizm parallel/variety. It is not autographed, vintage, or a reprint. The card number is F-23, and it is part of the 2023 Panini Prizm set. This sports trading card is perfect for collectors and fans of AJ Brown and the Philadelphia Eagles.
